Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَتْبَاعُ الرُّسُلِ وَمُصَدِّقُوهُمْ
Translation: O Allah, and the followers of the messengers and those who believed in them

Arabic text: مِنْ أَهْلِ الَارْضِ بِالْغَيْبِ عِنْدَ مُعَارَضَةِ الْمُعَانِدِيْنَ لَهُمْ
Translation: From among the people of the earth in the unseen, when confronted by those who opposed them

Arabic text: بِالتَّكْذِيبِ وَالْإِشْتِيَاقِ إِلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ بِحَقَائِقِ الَايْمَانِ
Translation: With denial, and those who yearned for the messengers with true faith

Arabic text: فِيْ كُلِّ دَهْرٍ وَزَمَانٍ أَرْسَلْتَ فِيهِ رَسُولًا، وَأَقَمْتَ لِأَهْلِهِ دَلِيْلًا
Translation: In every era and time in which You sent a messenger, and established for its people a guide

Arabic text: مِنْ لَدُنْ آدَمَ إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنْ أَئِمَّةِ الْهُدَى
Translation: From the time of Adam to Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, from among the Imams of guidance

Arabic text: وَقَادَةِ أَهْلِ التُّقَى عَلَى جَمِيْعِهِمُ السَّلاَمُ
Translation: And the leaders of the pious, peace be upon all of them

Arabic text: فَاذْكُرْهُمْ مِنْكَ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَرِضْوَانٍ
Translation: So remember them with Your forgiveness and pleasure

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ خَاصَّةً الَّذِيْنَ أَحْسَنُوْا الصَّحَابَةَ
Translation: O Allah, and especially the companions of Muhammad who excelled in companionship

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ أَبْلُوْا الْبَلاَءَ الْحَسَنَ فِيْ نَصْرِهِ
Translation: And those who offered excellent assistance in supporting him

Arabic text: وَكَانَفُوهُ وَأَسْرَعُوْا إِلَى وِفَادَتِهِ وَسَابَقُوْا إِلَى دَعْوَتِهِ
Translation: And surrounded him, and hastened to his delegation, and raced to his call

Arabic text: وَاسْتَجَابُوْا لَهُ حَيْثُ أَسْمَعَهُمْ حُجَّةَ رِسَالَاتِهِ
Translation: And responded to him when he made them hear the proof of his message

Arabic text: وَفَارَقُوْا الْأَزْوَاجَ وَالْأَوْلاَدَ فِيْ إِظْهَارِ كَلِمَتِهِ
Translation: And separated from their spouses and children to uphold his message

Arabic text: وَقَاتَلُوْا الْآبَاءَ وَالْأَبْنَاءَ فِيْ تَثْبِيْتِ نُبُوَّتِهِ
Translation: And fought against their fathers and sons to establish his prophethood

Arabic text: وَانْتَصَرُوْا بِهِ وَمَنْ كَانُوْا مُنْطَوِينَ عَلَى
Translation: And they were victorious with him, and they were filled with

Arabic text: مَحَبَّتِهِ يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ فِيْ مَوَدَّتِهِ
Translation: His love, hoping for a trade that will never perish in his affection

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ هَجَرَتْهُمُ الْعَشَائِرُ إِذْ تَعَلَّقُوْا بِعُرْوَتِهِ
Translation: And those whose tribes abandoned them when they clung to his faith

Arabic text: وَانْتَفَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْقَرَابَاتُ إِذْ سَكَنُوْا فِيْ ظِلِّ قَرَابَتِهِ
Translation: And their relatives disowned them when they dwelled in the shade of his kinship

Arabic text: فَلَا تَنْسَ لَهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ مَا تَرَكُوْا لَكَ وَفِيكَ
Translation: So do not forget, O Allah, what they left for You and in Your cause

Arabic text: وَأَرْضِهِمْ مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَبِمَا حَاشُوْا الْخَلْقَ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: And please them with Your pleasure for how they directed people to You

Arabic text: وَكَانُوْا مَعَ رَسُولِكَ دُعَاةً لَكَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And they were with Your Messenger, calling to You

Arabic text: وَاشْكُرْهُمْ عَلَى هَجْرِهِمْ فِيكَ دِيَارَ قَوْمِهِمْ
Translation: And reward them for abandoning their people's homes for Your sake

Arabic text: وَخُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ سَعَةِ الْمَعَاشِ إِلَى ضِيقِهِ
Translation: And for leaving a life of comfort for hardship

Arabic text: وَمَنْ كَثَّرْتَ فِيْ إِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ مِنْ مَظْلُومِهِمْ
Translation: And for how many of them were oppressed in strengthening Your religion

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَوْصِلْ إِلَى التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ، اَلَّذِيْنَ يَقُولُونَ
Translation: O Allah, and extend to those who followed them in goodness, those who say

Arabic text: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلْإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيْمَانِ خَيْرَ جَزَائِكَ
Translation: "Our Lord, forgive us and our brethren who preceded us in faith," the best of Your rewards

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْنَ قَصَدُوْا سَمْتَهُمْ، وَتَحَرُّوْا وَجْهَتَهُمْ، وَمَضُوْا عَلَى شَاكِلَتِهِمْ
Translation: Those who sought their path, pursued their direction, and followed their way

Arabic text: لَمْ يَثْنِهِمْ رَيْبٌ فِيْ بَصِيرَتِهِمْ، وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِجْهُمْ شَكٌّ
Translation: No doubt hindered their insight, and no suspicion confused them

Arabic text: فِيْ قَفْوِ آثَارِهِمْ وَالْإِئْتِمَامِ بِهِدَايَةِ مَنَارِهِمْ
Translation: In following their footsteps and being guided by the light of their guidance

Arabic text: مُكَانِفِينَ وَمُوَازِرِينَ لَهُمْ، يَدِينُونَ بِدِينِهِمْ، وَيَهْتَدُوْنَ بِهَدْيِهِمْ
Translation: Supporting and assisting them, following their religion, and being guided by their guidance

Arabic text: يَتَّفِقُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَلَا يَتَّهِمُوْنَهُمْ فِيمَا أَدُّوْا إِلَيْهِمْ
Translation: Agreeing with them, and not suspecting what they conveyed to them

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى التَّابِعِينَ مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon the followers from this day of ours until the Day of Judgment

Arabic text: وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ، وَعَلَى ذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ
Translation: And upon their spouses, and upon their descendants

Arabic text: وَعَلَى مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ مِنْهُمْ صَلاَةً تَعْصِمُهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: And upon those among them who obey You, blessings that protect them from disobeying You

Arabic text: وَتَفْسَحُ لَهُمْ فِيْ رِيَاضِ جَنَّتِكَ، وَتَمْنَعُهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ كَيْدِ الشَّيْطَانِ
Translation: And make room for them in the gardens of Your Paradise, and protect them from the plots of Satan

Arabic text: وَتُعِينُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى مَا اسْتَعَانُوكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ
Translation: And help them with what they seek Your help for in righteousness

Arabic text: وَتَقِيهِمْ طَوَارِقَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ
Translation: And guard them from the incidents of night and day except for that which brings good

Arabic text: وَتَبْعَثُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى اعْتِقَادِ حُسْنِ الرَّجَاءِ لَكَ
Translation: And inspire them to have good hope in You

Arabic text: وَالطَّمَعِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَتَرْكِ التُّهَمَةِ فِيمَا تَحْوِيهِ
Translation: And to desire what is with You, and to abandon suspicion in what is in

Arabic text: أَيْدِيْ الْعِبَادِ لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إِلَى الرَّغْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ
Translation: The hands of the servants, to return them to desire for You and fear of You

Arabic text: وَتُزَهِّدَهُمْ فِيْ سَعَةِ الْعَاجِلِ وَتُحَبِّبَ إِلَيْهِمُ
Translation: And make them disinterested in the abundance of this world and make beloved to them

Arabic text: اَلْعَمَلَ لِلْآجِلِ، وَالْإِسْتِعْدَادَ لِمَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَتُهَوِّنَ عَلَيْهِمْ
Translation: Working for the hereafter, and preparing for what comes after death, and make easy for them

Arabic text: كُلَّ كَرْبٍ يَحُلُّ بِهِمْ يَوْمَ خُرُوجِ الْأَنْفُسِ مِنْ أَبْدَانِهَا
Translation: Every difficulty that befalls them on the day when souls depart from their bodies

Arabic text: وَتُعَافِيَهُمْ مِمَّا تَقَعُ بِهِ الْفِتْنَةُ مِنْ مَحْذُورَاتِهَا
Translation: And protect them from the trials that lead to forbidden things

Arabic text: وَكَبَّةِ النَّارِ وَطُولِ الْخُلُودِ فِيهَا
Translation: And from the intensity of the Fire and the lengthy eternity therein

Arabic text: وَتُصَيِّرَهُمْ إِلَى أَمْنٍ مِنْ مَقِيلِ الْمُتَّقِينَ
Translation: And deliver them to the security of the resting place of the pious
